notes: Flex-Force Power System 60V MAX 22 in. Recycler walk mower with Personal Pace self-propel, sold with a 6.0 Ah battery and a charger (21466T is the same mower without battery or charger; 21468 ships with the 7.5 Ah pack).

gaps: The catalog does not say what the module contains.

Toro's 60v WPM Service Manual (Form 3429-828 Rev A, https://toro.com/getpub/169620) also calls the motor a 60 volt 2 kW brushless DC motor and says the battery and charger each have an internal non-serviceable fuse and the charger can cool a hot battery with an internal fan, but its spec table na...
No board-level parts documented; no teardown of the 88660 pack naming its cells was found.
The hood also carries 2 magnets (114-5896) of unstated type, left out.
method: Sources: Toro parts catalog Form 3441-857 Rev C (model 21466, serial 400000000 and up, (c) 2023), operator's manual Form 3441-853 Rev B (covers 21466, 21466T and 21468, (c) 2021) and the toro.com product page; the PDFs were read as text on 2026-11-12.
The parts catalog lists both a 'Motor Module 60V' (140-4125, Blade Drive Assembly page) and the bare 'Motor-2Kw' (140-4119, Motor and Lower Shroud page).
The 2 kW figure is from the catalog's part description, not a separate rating table.
The toro.com product page gives the motor type as Brushless DC and calls the included battery 'L324 (6.0Ah, 324Wh)'; the operator's manual gives the same 6.0 Ah / 324 Wh for pack model 88660.

comps.spec: Toro Flex-Force lithium-ion pack model 88660, 6.0 Ah, 324 Wh; maker's rating 60 V maximum, 54 V nominal; the manual says it is provided with the 21466
Toro 60V MAX lithium-ion charger model 88602 (2 A); input 120 V AC 50/60 Hz max 2.0 A, output 60V MAX DC 2.0 A
Motor-2Kw, part no. 140-4119, qty 1 (Motor and Lower Shroud Assembly ref. 2); the Blade Drive Assembly page lists Motor Module 60V, part no. 140-4125
Controller-Motor, part no. 140-4164, qty 1 (Motor and Lower Shroud Assembly ref. 10)
Battery Receiver ASM, part no. 139-6632 (Motor and Lower Shroud Assembly ref. 7)
Bail Switch ASM, part no. 133-1918, with extension spring 104-6478 (ref. 15 and 15:4)
Switch-Starter ASM, part no. 140-4145 (Starter Switch Assembly ref. 2)
Harness-Wire, part no. 139-6637 (Motor and Lower Shroud Assembly ref. 16)
Transmission-Rwd (rear-wheel self-propel transmission), part no. 139-6561, with two 15-tooth pinion gears 131-5399
V-Belt, part no. 140-4041 (Rear Wheel and HOC Assembly ref. 15, listed with the Rwd transmission and Rwd belt cover)
Bearing-Ball, part no. 104-8699 (Rear Wheel and HOC Assembly ref. 11)
